svg.title: Server and LSP tests register a feature module
svg.desc: Tests embedding the server replace the removed options field with an explicitly constructed tidy module. The existing test inputs and assertions are retained; only setup changes. The LSP fixture already supplies its FeatureModuleSet to the server.
svg.text: Server and LSP tests register a feature module
Tests embedding the server replace the removed options field with an explicitly constructed tidy module.
// Check that registering the boost-use-ranges checker's matchers
// on two different threads does not cause a crash.
// Check that registering the boost-use-ranges checker's matchers
// on two different threads does not cause a crash.
The existing test inputs and assertions are retained; only setup changes.
The LSP fixture already supplies its FeatureModuleSet to the server.
Colors follow git diff · unchanged context is gray · arrows map responsibilities, not entire excerpts
